ui.shortlistIntro: A short film-and-TV selection for this page. Each note explains the choice; explore a title or use it to shape your next match.
ui.moreHeading: More films and shows to explore
ui.availability: Platform tags describe catalog associations, not a confirmed offer in your country. Check the exact title and viewing options before paying.
ui.otherIntro: Prefer listening, reading or creators? Choose a format explicitly.
ui.otherCatalog: Show other formats in this collection

reasons.dune: Desert warfare and a struggle for power make this a choice for large-scale spectacle and sustained tension.
reasons.shogun: Rival interests and political maneuvering in feudal Japan reward attention when you want high-stakes drama.
reasons.andhadhun: A pianist's deception becomes a crime puzzle, making this a good starting point for twists and escalating suspense.
reasons.bear: A pressured restaurant kitchen and a family loss give this series its raw, emotionally demanding intensity.
reasons.kingdom: A royal investigation becomes a plague-and-zombie story, combining political intrigue with horror rather than gentle viewing.
reasons.severance: Divided work and personal memories make an ordinary office unsettling and give you a mystery to piece together.
reasons.rrr: A friendship between two revolutionaries anchors expansive action and an adventure with a strong emotional center.
reasons.starTrek: Exploring unfamiliar worlds with an established crew gives this series a clear sense of adventure and discovery.
reasons.laapataa: A mix-up during a train journey opens into a warm comedy about identity and independence.
reasons.tedLasso: An optimistic coach trying to win over a skeptical team brings humor through relationships and gradual trust.
reasons.threeIdiots: Friendship and arguments with a rigid education system give this comedy a purpose beyond its jokes.
reasons.businessProposal: A disguised blind date with the heroine's own boss provides a clear romantic-comedy setup.
reasons.crashLanding: An unexpected meeting across the Korean border creates a central romance with both affection and danger.
reasons.firstLove: Looking back at a youthful romance makes this a fit for remembered feelings and love shaped by time.
reasons.roma: Its intimate view of a domestic worker and a family in 1970s Mexico City suits reflective, emotionally weighty viewing.
reasons.alcarras: A family's threatened final harvest connects loss with the everyday routines and place they may have to leave.
reasons.queenTears: A marriage facing betrayal and serious illness makes this an emotionally demanding romance, not a light escape.
reasons.queen: A woman finding independence on a solo honeymoon offers a hopeful starting point for change and self-discovery.
reasons.midnightDiner: Recurring meals and the lives of a small diner's regulars offer familiar rhythms and human-scale stories.
reasons.chefsTable: Attention to chefs and their craft makes this a choice for absorbing food stories and creative dedication.
reasons.americanBaking: A recognizable sequence of baking challenges offers the comfort of a familiar competition format.
reasons.dangal: A father training his daughters against local resistance puts effort, ambition and sporting progress at the center.
reasons.cosmos: Questions about space, time and scientific discovery make this a starting point for curiosity and a wider perspective.
reasons.silo: An engineer questioning the rules of an underground society gives this mystery a clear thread of discovery.
reasons.frieren: A long-lived mage's reflection on friendship offers thoughtful fantasy; mortality and grief are central themes.
reasons.jujutsu: A cursed talisman and a school battling supernatural threats make this a direct choice for action-oriented dark fantasy.
reasons.soloLeveling: A weak hunter gaining strength after a deadly dungeon gives this action fantasy a clear progression to follow.
reasons.acesso: A presenter's exploration of cities through their history offers a documentary route into places and their stories.
